canonical_title: OpenAI contracts Firmus AI compute capacity from two Malaysia sites
aliases: OpenAI Firmus Malaysia data centre deal
treatment: Repeat only for disclosed OpenAI-contracted MW, contract value, site locations/timelines, commissioning milestones, or material changes to the NVIDIA Vera Rubin deployment.
known_facts: OpenAI and Firmus announced a multi-year strategic partnership for dedicated AI compute capacity from two Firmus AI Factory sites in Malaysia.
OpenAI will become an anchor customer of Firmus.
Firmus says total contracted capacity across all customers now exceeds 900 MW; this is not stated as OpenAI's own contracted share.

Firmus says its broader platform spans seven AI factories across Australia, Singapore, Indonesia and Malaysia, with two operational and five under development targeting ready-for-service within 24 months.
Firmus says its HyperCube-based AI factories will use NVIDIA DSX and NVIDIA Vera Rubin NVL72 systems.
reinclude_only_if: OpenAI-specific contracted capacity or contract value is disclosed.
Malaysia site locations, power capacity, or ready-for-service dates are disclosed.
A commissioning or production-service milestone occurs.
The hardware platform or strategic scope materially changes.
notes: Do not misattribute Firmus' >900 MW total contracted portfolio to OpenAI; OpenAI-specific MW and contract value are undisclosed.
